headline: Frequent Rework of OAuth2 Security Components
diagnosis: The OAuth2 security components are undergoing frequent changes, primarily due to typos, documentation updates, and minor bug fixes. This indicates a lack of clarity in the initial implementation and documentation, leading to ongoing adjustments.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the OAuth2PasswordRequestForm class and its associated documentation to identify and correct any unclear or ambiguous sections.
Establish a clear set of guidelines for commit messages to ensure that changes are well-documented and easily traceable, reducing the need for future reworks.
Implement automated tests to cover the critical functionalities of the OAuth2 components, ensuring that any changes do not introduce new issues.
Organize a code review session with the team to discuss the recent changes and gather feedback on potential improvements to the OAuth2 implementation.
owner_hint: The team responsible for the OAuth2 implementation should take ownership of these changes.
